title: Computation Note: Amount of the Billing-Error Credit on a Rental Vehicle Coordination Time Charge
content:
**Computation.** On a customer-pay Rental Vehicle Coordination rental tied to a network repair, the billing-error credit on the time charge equals the time charge posted on the final invoice, less the corrected time charge, less every billing-error credit already standing on the rental, never below zero, rounded to the cent once at the end. The corrected time charge is the rental days multiplied by the class partner daily rate. Rental days are the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day.

## Quantities and where they are read

| Quantity | Read from |
|---|---|
| Time charge posted on the final invoice | The customer's uncovered-days charge on the final invoice of the rental, in the rental's day and money history |
| Billing-error credits already standing | Every customer credit with reason billing error on the rental |
| Rental days | The pickup date and time and the return date and time on the reservation |
| Class partner daily rate | The class rate schedule, for the class rented |

## Structure of the amount

1. The rental days are the whole days from the pickup date to the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day.
2. The corrected time charge is those rental days multiplied by the class partner daily rate.
3. The credit before rounding is the posted time charge, less the corrected time charge, less the billing-error credits already standing.
4. Where that figure is below zero the credit is zero; the credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

A Compact Rental at a partner daily rate of 42.99 USD is picked up on a Monday at 09:00 and returned on the following Monday at 10:00. The whole days between the two dates are 7, and the return time is later than the pickup time, so the rental has 8 rental days. The corrected time charge is 8 days at 42.99 USD, 343.92 USD. With a posted time charge of 400.00 USD and no billing-error credit standing, the credit is 400.00 less 343.92, that is 56.08 USD.

Had the same rental been returned on the following Monday at 08:00, it would have 7 rental days, a corrected time charge of 300.93 USD and, against the same posted 400.00 USD, a credit of 99.07 USD. Had a billing-error credit of 56.08 USD already stood on the 8-day rental, the credit would be zero.
